name: Backstabber
overview: The Scriptures reveal the grave betrayal committed by backstabbers—those who turn against close friends and break covenants of peace, as seen in Psalms where trusted companions lift their heel against the faithful. Such individuals sow strife and division among friends through whispering and falsehood, as Proverbs warns that a man who bears false witness is like a sharp weapon causing harm. The Bible clearly condemns deceit and treachery, emphasizing that those who speak lies and break trust will not escape punishment.
